correctness.rationale: The fully specified 21-vertex categorical product has exactly 5281 nonempty independent faces, independently enumerated by binary vertex decisions. The 2635-pair matching passes a complete 25242-cover DAG topological-sort check, leaving a CW model with one 0-cell, four 3-cells and six 4-cells. A signed gradient-path projection, reconstructed by the bundled verifier, gives the exact displayed \(4\times6\) integral differential; two rows agree and a \(3\times3\) minor has determinant -1, so the Smith factors are 1,1,1. The attaching-map Hurewicz isomorphism in degree three then gives the stated wedge homotopy equivalence. An independent mod-two elimination of all original simplicial boundaries gives Betti dimensions 1 and 3. The 84 natural automorphisms are checked against the graph; oriented Lefschetz traces are exhaustively enumerated and together with order-seven rational representation constraints uniquely determine the stated degree-3 and degree-4 characters. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite-family proof.

originality.rationale: The 2023 primary paper explicitly lists the same graph \(C_7\times K_3\) as an example with free homology in two degrees, but its Theorem 23 allows Moore torsion and Question 24 asks torsion-freeness. The new unimodular integral matrix and the complete natural dihedral–color character are not logical consequences of its claim. Published four-color \(C_7\times K_4\) results treat a different graph and a different natural group. The 2025 path-product formulas were compared as a possible indirect route; no direct coverage of \(C_7\times K_3\) was identified in the inspected material, but indirect derivability remains a residual risk. value.rationale: The target \(C_7\times K_3\) is expressly one of the examples identified immediately before a published torsion-freeness question, and is the smallest odd seven-cycle with three complete-graph colors in that named list. Exact integer Smith data exclude the previously allowed Moore-space torsion and determine the homotopy type. The complete natural \(D_7\times S_3\) rational character discriminates nontrivial reflection and color sign actions not captured by the known free Betti support. This is a natural finite topological boundary case and an additional symmetry invariant, not a conjectural all-parameter theorem or a routine restatement of \(C_7\times K_4\).
